描述_EN: the first corgi diecast models were made by mettoy in 1956, and were marketed as 'the ones with windows'. the other vehicles in the range included a tx1 taxi, a mini, the concorde and a tube train. its official authenticitywais guaranteed by a holographic sticker on the reverse. it was sold as part of the corgi product range, in a presentation box emblazoned with london 2012 logos and featuring 'did you know?' facts, designed to appeal to children and adult collectors. this red double decker bus is one of a series of 'great british classics' produced by hornby hobbies ltd in the run up to the 2012 olympic games. this routemaster bus, first seen on the streets of london in the same year, features not only windows, but also olympic route numbers and an open platform at the back.
描述_ZN: 第一个corgi压铸模型是由mettoy在1956年制造的，并被销售为 "有窗户的"。 该系列的其他车辆包括T1出租车、迷你车、协和车和地铁列车。 其官方真实性是由背面的全息贴纸保证的。 它是作为corgi产品系列的一部分出售的，装在一个印有2012年伦敦奥运会标志的礼盒中，并有 "你知道吗？"的内容，旨在吸引儿童和成人收藏家。 这个红色的双层巴士是Hornby hobbies ltd在2012年奥林匹克运动会之前生产的一系列 "伟大的英国经典 "之一。 这款Routemaster巴士，同年首次出现在伦敦的街道上，不仅有窗户，还有奥运会的路线编号和后面的开放平台。
